summary: Frontend-only verification of the Cinema page additions: live search (title + director), sort (Selection/Newest/Oldest), YouTube/Vimeo trailer block in film modal, admin 'Bande-annonce' field. All 7 review items pass. No code changes made.

admin.note: Items collapsed by default; the 'Bande-annonce' visible label appears when expanded. Did not save (no persistence).

FR.placeholder: Rechercher un titre ou un réalisateur

EN.placeholder: Search a title or a director

critical_code_review_comments: FilmToolbar.useFilmQuery normalises accents with NFD and filters on `${title} ${director}` — matches review spec exactly.

FilmGrid uses AnimatePresence with exit transition ~0.7s; during search typing, old cards remain mounted until exit completes. The no-result message correctly reflects the already-filtered list (not DOM count), so UX is still truthful. Fine as-is.

Trailer component in FilmGrid.jsx renders ABOVE NetflixLink JSX order (verified by DOM bounding rects). toPlayable regex covers both youtube.com/watch?v=, youtu.be, embed, shorts and vimeo.com/<id> / vimeo.com/video/<id>.
FilmModal close triggers AnimatePresence exit; after 1500ms modal is unmounted and iframe is fully removed from DOM — YouTube/Vimeo playback stops as expected.

withNewPages() in i18n.js correctly backfills { trailer: '' } for legacy saved films so the admin always sees the Bande-annonce input (confirmed via cms-films.N.trailer testids in the Cinéma admin tab).
Mobile toolbar at 390px has no horizontal overflow and all three sort buttons sit on one line thanks to whitespace-nowrap + sm:px-3 padding reduction. Good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 review items pass. Search uses NFD normalisation on title+director; sort has three states (default/new/old) with underline on active; chip order and chip testid indices (film-filter-0/1/2) remain stable regardless of sort or search. Trailer block uses toPlayable() for YouTube/Vimeo and renders inline inside the modal above NetflixLink. Admin Cinéma tab exposes cms-films.N.trailer inputs (collapsed by default). lang-toggle-fr/-en testids drive i18n.
